text: You've got ten thousand fucking contacts in ManyChat, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Ten thousand, bro, and nobody buys. So tonight I blast them all.
style: Hyped and proud, a casual American guy on a film set, showing off his big plan to his buddy.

text: When a lead DMs you, Meta gives you twenty-four hours.
style: Flat and deadpan, slowly, like explaining something obvious to a kid.

text: Half of them messaged me in March.
style: Casual and a bit smug, shrugging, not getting it yet.

text: After that, no more automated messages. ManyChat won't even send them.
style: Mocking and sharp, a small beat before the last sentence, landing it hard.

text: Wait, so I can't even message them anymore?
style: Shocked and confused, voice rising at the end.

text: By hand, within seven days, no promo. March is a graveyard, bro.
style: Quick and dry on the rules, then slow, smug and mocking on the last sentence.

text: So ManyChat locked my own list?
style: Annoyed and offended, looking for someone to blame.

text: Nope, Meta did. ManyChat just follows the rules.
style: Deadpan, a beat after 'Nope, Meta did', then calm and matter-of-fact.

text: So how do I sell to them?
style: Pleading and a little desperate, giving in.

text: While they're talking. Every message buys you twenty-four fresh hours.
style: Confident and warm, like sharing the real secret, a small beat after the first sentence.

text: I film all day. I reply two days later.
style: Defeated and honest, like a confession, a sigh in the voice.

text: Plug me into ManyChat. I answer once they're done typing, then send up to three follow-ups inside those twenty-four hours.
style: Smooth and sly, then fast, confident and rhythmic, like listing flexes.

text: Okay. How do I set you up?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: Step off the green screen. You're pitching nobody next to a fake fucking Lambo.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug, savoring the end.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
